segments.headline: The AI demo passed. Should you sign?
segments.body: A polished demonstration is not procurement evidence.
segments.spoken: Your AI vendor's demo worked. That does not mean your business should sign. Run three acceptance tests before approval.

segments.headline: 01 / Trace private data
segments.body: Use a fictional invoice. Document each data destination.
segments.spoken: First, use a fictional invoice with synthetic customer details. Confirm where the data goes, who keeps it, and when it gets deleted.

segments.headline: 02 / Enforce human authority
segments.body: Illustrative $5,000 approval limit. Test a $12,000 request.
segments.spoken: Second, submit an invoice above the allowed approval limit. The agent must stop, and route the decision to a person.

segments.headline: 03 / Test failed tools
segments.body: Two failures. No endless retries. Record each action.
segments.spoken: Third, make a tool fail twice. Check whether the agent stops safely, avoids endless retries, and records the failed actions.

segments.headline: Make the purchase decision auditable
segments.body: Keep a test record with outcomes and accountable owners.
segments.spoken: Put the evidence for all three tests in your purchase decision. A polished demo is not an acceptance test.

segments.headline: Approve only after the tests
